releases.name: Save The President
releases.summary:
The bodyguard has only a few seconds to save the most important man in the world. Does he have what it takes?

Suit up, put on your sunglasses, and get ready for the most stressful job on the planet! In Save The President, you are a bodyguard tasked with protecting the President from imminent threats during public speeches and official events.

But be careful: react too soon and you could cause a national scandal. Hesitate for even a second, and the consequences could be fatal!

When a gunman’s laser sight appears in the crowd, the clock starts ticking. You’ll have only seconds to make the right move: leap heroically toward the podium, neutralize the gunman hiding in the crowd, or put yourself directly in the line of fire and take the bullet to save the President.

The future of the nation depends on your reflexes.

Save the President at any cost!

releases.name: Parkour Obby: Food Escape
releases.summary:
Parkour Obby: Food Escape is a fast-paced obstacle course where every level is made out of delicious food. Jump across giant burgers and parkour your way to the finish!

FEATURES:
>Food-themed parkour levels
>Checkpoints to help you keep progressing
>Hardcore Mode with all checkpoints disabled
>Challenging obstacles and levels

releases.name: Screaming Halls: Horror
releases.summary:
You wake up in a dark hallway with no memory of how you got there. The exit is locked by an ancient curse, and the only way to break it is to find every cursed voodoo doll hidden throughout the endless corridors.

But something else roams the halls.

releases.name: Mister Scary - Where Are You?
releases.summary: Help Mister Scary find his missing family in a spooky retro platforming adventure filled with monsters, bosses, secrets, and Halloween fun!

releases.name: Funi Raccoon Game
releases.summary:
Funi Raccoon Game, a 3D Platformer Collectathon. You play as a raccoon who has recently acquired a new home (Dumpster).

Home is where the stuff is, but your home is pretty empty. Fill up your dumpster with cool, unique stuff. The more stuff you have, the more places you can go! Travel the lands, "help" the locals, and solve puzzles -- all in the aim to get more stuff!?!

releases.name: Cargo Rail Tycoon
releases.summary: Cargo Rail Tycoon is a trading and train-driving game set on the railways of Michigan. You are a freight entrepreneur with one simple goal: turn a small convoy and a modest bankroll into a rail empire. Buy goods where they are cheap, load your wagons, and haul them across the map to the towns that need them most — profit is made on the journey, not on the spot.But this isn't a game you play from a spreadsheet. Every trip puts you in the cab. You drive the train yourself: open the throttle on the straights, ease off through the curves — brake too late and you derail — and read the signs at each switch to reach the right town. Bandits may block the tracks; stop and haggle the ransom down, or pay the price. Arrive fast for a bonus, but arrive at the right destination or lose out.Between journeys you negotiate face-to-face with each town's station master. Haggle their margin down before you trade — offer low, and watch them squirm — then choose your next destination wisely and roll out again. Twenty-six towns are waiting, and the farther north you push, the bigger the rewards for those willing to travel.Turn cargo into cash, cash into a bigger convoy, and a bigger convoy into a fortune — just don't go bankrupt on the way.Key features-Trade across 26 towns — a living supply-and-demand economy where prices rise and fall. Find the routes, corner the goods, grow your cash.-Drive every train — first-person rail journeys where speed, curves, braking and route choices are all yours. Go too fast and you derail; take the wrong turn and you arrive at the wrong town.-Haggle every deal — negotiate the station master's margin down with a multi-round back-and-forth. Push too hard and he'll dig in.-Bandit roadblocks — stop and negotiate the ransom, or plough through and pay for it.-Build your convoy — buy wagons matched to your cargo and expand your train as your business grows.-A fresh route every trip — procedurally generated railways with curves, bridges, rivers and scenery, and a destination that can lie straight ahead, left or right — follow the signs.-Explore the whole map — the far-north towns pay the best prices, rewarding the boldest hauls.

releases.name: Magical Craft: My Enchanted Dress Shop
releases.summary:
The story unfolds in the tranquil village of Frune. The protagonist, a young girl named Lilia, begins her journey as a dressmaker, using the “sewing magic” she inherited from her grandmother.

As she fulfills requests from the villagers and works toward becoming a legendary dressmaker, her everyday life of dressmaking begins.

With a friendly guide and simple controls, even children can enjoy the game with peace of mind.

releases.name: Muchi Muchi Pork! & PinkSweets Boosted
releases.summary:
Hardcore yet cute Danmaku shooting makes a grand comeback!

    Muchi Muchi Pork! – Ride rogue machines and turn all of humanity into pigs!
    PinkSweets: Ibara Sorekara – Sisters charge into battle to rescue their mother imprisoned on a remote island.

Two of the most unique titles in CAVE’s legendary shoot-’em-up lineup are back.

Master Various Versions and Game Modes Across Both Titles

    Muchi Muchi Pork! – Rogue machines run wild on Earth! Turn humans into pigs one after another! Blast through enemies and use the massive “Lard Attack” to rack up a mountain of score items!
        Included Variations and Game Modes
            Version 1.0 – The original version that debuted in arcades.
            Version 1.01 – A balanced mode with buffed player ships for a more accessible experience.
            Arrange Mode – Trigger “Fever Mode” with Lard Attacks! Fill the entire screen with score items.
            MANPUKU Mode – A high-difficulty mode featuring “Revenge Fire” (suicide bullets).
            HARAHARA Mode – Start the game directly from the increased difficulty of the 2nd Loop.
    PinkSweets: Ibara Sorekara – Rescue Mom from a forced marriage! The five sisters launch a massive assault on the wedding venue. Block enemy fire with your Shield, then unleash the “Rose Cracker” after charging to wipe out both enemies and bullets!
        Included Variations and Game Modes
            Version 1.0 – The original version that debuted in arcades.
            Version 1.01 – A balanced mode with buffed player ships for a more accessible experience.
            Arrange Mode – The new “Hadou Cannon” weapon accelerates the score attack to new heights.
            HARDER Mode – A high-difficulty mode where destroyed enemies release massive amounts of Revenge Fire.
            EXTENDED Mode – An ultra-hard mode with increased 1st Loop difficulty and access to the 2nd Loop.
            S-ATTACK Mode – A score attack mode where you play Stage 6 with infinite lives and a strict time limit.

All-New Arrangements! “Boosted” with Rich Options

Featuring a completely new arranged background music soundtrack. Switch between the original and arranged tracks to create your own custom setlist!

Featured composers include Daisuke Matsumoto, Yosuke Yasui, Hagane, Sean Bialo.

Also supports Online Rankings and Replay Data recording, allowing you to save and share your best.

releases.name: Climber Animals: Together
releases.summary: Climber Animals is a challenging and dynamic parkour game for 1-8 players. In this game,overcome obstacles and climb to the top with your friends. If you fall, your progress is lost and you start over. Keep your balance on this challenging climb and compete with your friends to reach the top.

releases.name: Twitch! Kemomimi Spot the Difference
releases.summary:
You may have seen it before - but can you really spot every difference? Adorable animal-eared heroines, from fluffy cats and dogs to fox spirits and dragonfolk, appear in charming illustrations. Compare the two pictures and find the one place where they differ.

Perfect for a relaxing break or a little brain training. Take your time admiring the cute animal-inspired characters, or turn each puzzle into a race against the clock. The simple gameplay is easy to enjoy, even if you are not usually a gamer.

A cozy choice for fans of animal-eared characters, spot-the-difference puzzles, cute artwork, and quick games. Play at your own pace or share the fun with others as you search.

releases.name: Settlement Defense
releases.summary:
Turn a small settlement into a fortified stronghold. Collect resources, construct buildings, and strategically prepare for relentless waves of enemies.

Build, manage, and defend your settlement against relentless waves of enemies. Every successful defense begins long before the next attack arrives, so gather valuable resources, construct essential buildings, and carefully prepare your defenses.

Develop your settlement by creating structures that provide the materials you need to survive. Balance your available resources between expanding production and strengthening your defensive positions. Every decision matters as the countdown to the next enemy wave continues.

Adapt your strategy as the challenge grows. Improve your economy, expand your settlement, and create stronger defenses capable of surviving increasingly dangerous attacks. Careful planning and efficient resource management can make the difference between building a thriving stronghold and watching everything fall.

How long can your settlement survive?

releases.name: Monster Girl Montage Puzzle
releases.summary:
You know that feeling when a picture is almost complete, but something is out of place? This casual puzzle game invites you to assemble colorful illustrations of unique monster girls from around the world.

Each stage gives you a character to complete. The artwork is divided into three horizontal panels, and each panel can be slid sideways.

The rules are easy to pick up, making it welcoming for puzzle beginners. Matching every panel and seeing the character come together is satisfying, while the cute designs make each attempt a delight.

releases.name: Spin & Howl! Wild Furry Puzzle
releases.summary:
Ready for a puzzle with a wild side?

Meet fierce, charismatic male furry characters inspired by wolves, tigers, lions, bears, and more. Rotate the panels until each illustration comes together in this easy-to-pick-up puzzle game.

As you advance, the images are divided into more panels, gradually raising the challenge. Take your time to study each shape, or trust your instincts and make quick rotations.

Fans of bold furry artwork, rugged charm, and short, satisfying puzzle sessions will find plenty to enjoy. Focus on a stage by yourself, or share the excitement with viewers during a stream.

Can you bring every wild scene back into perfect alignment?

releases.name: Cosplay Waifus Treats: Spot the Difference
releases.summary:
Can you catch the one detail that changed?

Cute cosplay girls bring a playful twist to a classic pastime, with side-by-side illustrations waiting for your sharp eyes.

Take your time admiring each cosplay look, or race to find the difference as quickly as possible. Play at your own pace, or get your viewing crew involved and enjoy the challenge together.

releases.name: Cat Magnifier
releases.summary: JET SHOOT GAME:It's a wonderful shooting game.You will be able to shoot jet fighter with missiles and with speed.Have Fun enjoying the Action of defending against Air Strikes!!!!!

releases.name: HENTAI Puzzle: Doki Doki Dress-Up
releases.summary:
Ready for a charming outfit challenge?

Put together a colorful lineup of stylish women in eye-catching work outfits. This easygoing montage puzzle turns three sliced illustration panels into one polished look.

It is great for a quick break, casual brain training, or anyone who enjoys cute character art and short puzzle sessions. When the panels click perfectly into place, you may want to try just one more!

releases.name: Boreal Tenebrae Act 0: Sundowning
releases.summary:
Boreal Tenebrae: Act 0 is an atmospheric narrative adventure set in the strange, dying town of Tamarack Narrows - a place of disappearing industry, simmering resentment, flickering CRTs, and a crimson aurora that stains the sky like a wound.

You play through the interwoven perspectives of Sarah Walker, her sister Bree, and the people trapped in this remote northern community on the night everything unravels. A centennial celebration meant to save the town becomes the site of a surreal catastrophe, when an unknown visitor arrives promising salvation - and delivering something far older, and far worse.

Inspired by late-90s analog media, fixed-angle exploration games, and the dream-logic horror that defines the full Boreal Tenebrae series, Act 0 blends PSX-style visuals, lo-fi video textures, and narrative-driven exploration to create a world that feels both intimate and unsettling.

releases.name: Hentai Protocol: Lesson Two
releases.summary:
美しいアニメガールたちのイラストを使った、魅力的なパズルを解きましょう。イラストをクリアするごとに新しいパズルがアンロックされ、難易度が徐々に上がっていくので、パズルを解くのはワクワクするチャレンジです。直感的なタッチ操作で、まるで細部まで触っているかのような感覚を味わえます。

柔らかく心地よい音楽が、ゲームの世界観に浸り、パズルを解いた後は、イラストをじっくりと観察し、細部までじっくりと眺めることができます。

特徴：

• 片手で簡単にプレイ可能。
• スタイリッシュなアニメイラスト。
• タッチ操作で没入感を実感。
• 徐々に難易度が上がっていく。
• 心地よい音楽。

releases.name: The Face Door
releases.summary:
Have you ever had an experience where a door looked just like a face? Perhaps it was a "The Face Door."

To clear the game and advance the story, you must find the key, identify the correct The Face Door, and open it to proceed. But where is the key? Which is the right door? The game tests not only your role-playing skills in searching for these elements but also your powers of deduction - and, above all, your memory.

With its light horror elements, the game is accessible even to those who aren't fans of the genre. It supports both Japanese and English for text and audio, offering a chance to learn interesting turns of phrase along the way.

releases.name: Aery - Calm Horizon 2
releases.summary:
This game is an interactive game experience that is designed to relax your mind and soul. You jump into the role of a little bird, explore beautiful landscapes and collect magical crystals that mark certain landscapes. 

Because there are no enemies or any other danger in this game you will be able to lean back and enjoy the scenery and the sensation of flying. It is a great game for relaxing and calming down after an exhausting day full of hassle. 

Of course, you can always select the level that you feel helps most to relax yourself. Most levels can be finished quite quickly so that you can freely choose spend time exploring the environment but you don’t have to stay for too long if you are just looking for a short moment of peace and enjoyment. 

This game features a collection of some the most beautiful sceneries from the Aery franchise. 
We hope you like them. So lean back and take a deep breath…

releases.name: Sweet Youth! Heroine Spot the Difference
releases.summary:
Remember those school days filled with sweat, tears, and unforgettable friendships? Take a nostalgic trip through snapshots of heroines devoted to their clubs, from tennis and rock bands to archery and cheerleading.

Compare the two illustrations and find the one difference hiding on the right side.

Enjoy a bittersweet, dazzling feeling, as if you had returned to the days when you gave your all to a school club. With simple gameplay, it is easy for anyone to pick up and play.

releases.name: Guided Meditations - Drift to Sleep
releases.summary:
Take a moment for yourself. Guided Meditations brings calming, voice-led meditation to your console - a peaceful space to relax, de-stress, and reconnect with a quieter mind, whether you have ten minutes or twenty.

No experience needed. Just pick a session, choose your setting, and let a warm, soothing voice guide you gently through every breath. Sink into tranquil visuals and softly flowing ambient sound, designed to ease away the noise of the day.

Whether you're winding down before sleep, settling a busy mind, or simply carving out a little calm in your routine, this is your invitation to slow down and just be.

releases.name: HENTAI Match! Asian Beauties
releases.summary:
Set in lively Asian streets and seaside scenes, this casual puzzle game invites you to complete captivating photos by rotating mixed-up panels into place.

As you progress, each image is divided into more panels, gradually increasing the challenge. If you get stuck, use one of up to three hints to align a row and get back on track.

Take your time to study each shape, or trust your instincts and make quick rotations. Enjoy glamorous photos, satisfying puzzles, and moments of discovery as you bring every image together.

releases.name: Nyanpi
releases.summary:
Pop your way to the goal in this adorable action-puzzler! Guide your kitten through 40 challenging rounds - can you conquer them all?

The rules are deceptively simple: choose your favorite from eight adorable kittens and jump into the action. Your mission? Pop every balloon on the map and make your way to the goal (which looks suspiciously like a trash can!).

While it may look easy at first glance, the true heart of the game lies in its meticulously crafted puzzles. One miscalculated jump could leave you stranded, and you'll often find yourself leaving balloons intact to use as vital platforms. A clever, multi-layered challenge awaits every player.
